items.title: Closed immersions are proper
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that a closed immersion is proper. The proof checks the three ingredients of properness: the base change of a closed immersion is a closed immersion, hence universally closed; a closed immersion is separated; and a closed immersion is of finite type.
